description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Their block was fine. It simply was not enough mass.

Your Strikes with a two-handed melee weapon reduce the target's circumstance bonus to AC from cover, a raised shield, or a similar physical obstruction by 1. Against a target taking cover behind an object you could break, reduce it by 2 instead.

cinderfall.incomplete: Strikes with a two-handed melee weapon reduce the target's own circumstance bonus to AC from cover/a raised shield/a similar obstruction by 1 (2 against breakable cover). No selector suppresses a target's own received circumstance bonus from the attacker's passive (same absence confirmed for second-ascendant) -- this is the inverse of granting the attacker a bonus and has no matching precedent.
